name: Lakshita Bajaj
text: The faculty is very helpful at all times. It's easy to understand and learn with them.

name: Naznin Mulji
text: ECCE is a wonderful course that deals with young minds. We are learning so many things about children that we were not aware of before. The notes help a lot, and the short videos by Tanishq Ma’am summarize the concepts, making them easier to understand. It is definitely a great platform for homemakers or mothers who are looking to do something productive in their free time. I am sure you will enjoy learning.

name: Shradha Vaibhav Arbooj
text: The ECCE course was excellent and easy to understand, thanks to the friendly faculty who made complex concepts simple. The assignments and assessments were challenging but provided valuable practice. Tanishq Ma’am's appreciation and motivation helped us grow, sharing real-life examples and current school experiences. The course empowered us to handle children effectively, find solutions, and understand each child's uniqueness. The sessions were lively, enthusiastic, and joyful, making learning a pleasure.

name: Indupame Jha
text: The ECCE course is very important for me as a teacher, as it has opened new opportunities. We learned how to present ourselves as teachers, contribute to the overall growth of learners, and build confidence. It is very helpful for teachers.

name: Velammal R
text: Pursuing the ECCE course has been a transformative journey that strengthened both my knowledge and passion for early childhood learning. Throughout the course, I gained a deeper understanding of child development, teaching methodologies, classroom management, and the importance of nurturing the emotional, social, and cognitive growth of young learners. Practical training, lesson planning, and hands-on classroom exposure allowed me to develop confidence in interacting with children, designing engaging activities, and creating a positive learning environment. The course helped me grow professionally, improved my observation and communication skills, and enriched my perspective on how early education lays the foundation for future learning.

name: Shabina Sabirali Sayed
text: The ECCE course was a great experience due to the excellent teaching style. The professor was inspiring and taught valuable life skills in addition to the academic material. Her dedication and creative teaching methods helped us understand complex topics better. The supportive attitude towards students made the learning environment comfortable. Overall, the course was highly beneficial and engaging.

name: Hema Behrani
text: The ECCE course was a good learning experience. Tanishq Ma’am made the sessions interactive and engaging. I learned about teaching aids and classroom management, which I will incorporate into my sessions.

name: Sonali Pranjal Madane
text: Best teaching.

name: Samruddhi Yogesh Shinde
text: This course is very helpful as I have learned many new aspects of early childhood education. It is helping me build confidence, and above all, Tanishq Ma’am explains all the topics very well.

name: Anjana Sahani
text: The course is good. The major drawback is that there are no hard copies of the notes provided for study. Although we can print them ourselves, it would be easier if the institution provided them directly.

name: Girija Appnadan
text: My experience in the ECCE course was very meaningful and helpful. I learned how children grow, learn, and behave during the early childhood stage. The course improved my understanding of teaching methods, classroom management, and activity-based learning.

name: Meghana Anmol Sonawane
text: I understand all the concepts of the ECCE course. Tanishq Ma’am explains everything clearly with examples. Because of this course, I have been able to improve my daily teaching. Thank you, Tanishq Ma’am.

name: Mrs. Vibha Vaibhav Wadkar
text: I am not able to attend the classes regularly as the timings are not very suitable for married women with children. Since our children also have classes in the evening, the only free time we get is when they are at school. Afternoon batches should also be provided so learners can choose timings according to their convenience.

name: Sonali Pranjal Madane
text: I've been supporting learners with the ECCE (Early Childhood Care and Education) course, helping them understand key concepts and skills. I've assisted with assignments, discussions, and projects, focusing on creating engaging and effective learning experiences for young children.

name: Harshada Badgujar
text: Good.

name: Kirti Phulwani
text: Very nice and easy to understand each and every concept taught by our trainers. They are really good.

name: Vidhi Shah
text: It’s a good experience.

name: Priya Shakti Rana
text: This teaching style was new to me. After learning under these teachers, I gained a lot of knowledge about handling young children in a school classroom.

name: Shreya (Testing)
text: Excellent.

name: Shravani Anant Nakade
text: Amazing experience. The faculty provides clear explanations and teaches with good examples, which help us understand topics quickly and easily.

name: Rupali Sandip Nimbalkar
text: The ECCE course is a quality program that enhances early childhood education skills. It teaches different teaching methods and helps us learn how to teach children effectively.

name: Ankita Nautiyal
text: I learned a lot from the ECCE course, and I would recommend it to everyone. It is very useful in life. Thanks to Tanishq Ma’am, who guided us so well.

name: Monika Shrivastava
text: Good teaching method.

name: Krishnarani Mandal
text: The ECCE course helps me understand the growth and development of young children. It teaches me how to support children’s learning through play, activities, and proper care. In this course, I learned about child development, health and nutrition, and effective teaching methods for preschoolers. It also helped me develop the skills needed to create a safe and engaging learning environment. Overall, this course is helping me become a confident and caring preschool teacher.

name: Shubhangi Sagar Khatake
text: Very good. The faculty provides study material and explains concepts in simple words.

name: Sapna Jain
text: I have learned a lot from the experienced mentors. The topics explained by them were easy to understand.

name: Jyoti Nitin Gambhirepatil
text: They provide study materials and explain concepts very well.

name: Jyoti Nitin Gambhirepatil
text: Very good. They provide materials and explain everything in very simple words.

name: Khushi
text: My experience in the ECCE course was very informative and enriching. The course helped me improve my understanding of educational concepts, communication skills, and practical applications. I gained knowledge through interactive sessions, teamwork, and hands-on activities. The faculty members were supportive and guided us throughout the course. Overall, the ECCE course enhanced my confidence, learning abilities, and professional skills, making it a valuable experience for my academic and personal growth.

name: Shravani Nakade
text: Good experience. The faculty explains concepts in a simple and concise manner.

name: Mrs. Pranal Kunal Dusane
text: Overall, my experience has been very good, and the knowledge gained from this course is very useful. Thank you.

name: Vidhi Behal
text: My experience with Hunorho's ECCE course has been excellent. Every point is explained clearly by the teachers. The details and notes are explained perfectly. I would recommend this course to others. Thank you for the wonderful experience.

name: Vaishnavi Nitesh Mhatre
text: My experience in the ECCE course was very informative and enjoyable. The course helped me understand the importance of early childhood education and the role of teachers in a child’s overall development. I learned different teaching methods, child development theories, and activity planning for young children. Overall, the ECCE course increased my confidence and prepared me to work effectively with young children in a caring and supportive environment.

name: Poonam S. Bhalerao
text: The course is excellently designed. The teachers are very talented and helpful. It was a good learning experience.
